description: Frontend.resolve's decisions before the module runs: the header guards, the module's gate, Unbound's silence, and the UDP and stream size limits

cases.description: a packet with the QR bit set is never answered, so a reflection loop cannot start
the QR check comes before any parsing: a response cut short is dropped, not answered with FORMERR
a packet shorter than the 12-byte header is dropped
a query with no question gets a header-only FORMERR
a query with two questions gets a header-only FORMERR
a question that does not parse gets a header-only FORMERR
a query with a non-zero opcode goes to Unbound unchanged although the name is listed
a query with the TC bit set goes to Unbound unchanged although the name is listed
a query that carries an answer record goes to Unbound unchanged
a query that carries an authority record goes to Unbound unchanged
a query with two additional records goes to Unbound unchanged, even when both are a root OPT of EDNS version 0
a question of class CH goes to Unbound unchanged: the module decides class IN and ANY only
a query with EDNS version 1 goes to Unbound unchanged
a query whose one additional record is owned by the root but is not an OPT goes to Unbound unchanged
a query whose OPT is not owned by the root goes to Unbound unchanged
Unbound's silence on a query it answers itself becomes a SERVFAIL the decider builds
Unbound's silence on a query the module deferred becomes a SERVFAIL the decider builds
a built answer over 512 bytes to a UDP client without EDNS is the question alone with TC set
a built answer over 512 bytes but within the client's EDNS size (1232) is sent whole over UDP
a stream client's built answer over 512 bytes is sent whole
a built answer over 65535 bytes cannot go on a stream, so the client gets a SERVFAIL
the same oversized answer to a UDP client is the truncated question, not a SERVFAIL
only a built answer is held to the UDP size: Unbound's own reply is relayed as it is
